name: Isolated Git and CLI agent execution
userOutcome: The user can run coding agents in separate branches, worktrees, and process sessions while observing live output and protected-branch safety.
productionDataSource: Registered repository, task claim, role/model policy, Git worktree, CLI process, and captured changes.
errorBehavior: Preserve logs and worktree state, stop owned process trees, identify existing changes or commits, and provide safe cleanup or resume choices.
prohibitedBehavior: Do not share a working directory between coding tasks.
Do not execute unapproved binaries or privilege escalation.
Do not delete an unowned worktree.
